BiblicalUsage: Hodu is the country of India, in the east, named 2 times in Scripture, in Esther. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hodu matters because God met His people in real places, not in abstractions. I hold that Hodu is worth knowing by name, even when the Bible says little about it.
